title: Daredevil Musthafa
desc: Ramanuja Iyengari and his gang are determined to get Musthafa expelled from their college. So, after a hilarious series of failed attempts, a riveting cricket match decides their fate.

title: Readymade Ganda
desc: A woman is determined to keep her assets from falling into the wrong hands. To protect her inheritance, she hires a fake husband.

title: Nenu Local
desc: Babu, a carefree graduate, falls in love with Keerthy, his classmate, and pursues a relationship with her. However, her father doesn't approve of their union and wants her to marry a successful man.

title: Solillada Saradara
desc: Krishna, a ferry driver, is about to marry Rukmini, the love of his life. However, things take a turn when a landlord's daughter falls for him.

title: Aparichita
desc: A writer visits his friend's village after he learns about his disappearance. On visiting the place, he discovers that the latter was murdered.
